evidence.name: Supereffective Pheromones
evidence.textEn: If you have Volbeat in play, apply Weakness for both Active Pokémon as ×3.
evidence.textZh: 如果自己场上有「电萤虫」的话，则能生效。只要这只宝可梦在场上，双方战斗宝可梦的弱点按「×3」计算伤害。

evidence.name: Life-Locked
evidence.textEn: Your opponent's Active Pokémon can't be healed.
evidence.textZh: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，对手的战斗宝可梦无法回复HP。
